chunks: Al-Ajlah, and Salamah ibn Kuhayl, and Dawud ibn Abi Yazid, and Zayd Al-Yamami narrated to me; they said: Shahr ibn Hawshab narrated to us.
That ʿAli (عليه السلام), when he went to Al-Kufah, entrusted his books and the bequest to Umm Salamah. Then when Al-Hasan (عليه السلام) returned, she handed them over to him.

key_terms.أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ: Umm Salamah, the custodian entrusted with the items
key_terms.الْحَسَنُ: Al-Hasan (عليه السلام), to whom the trust was delivered
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: Al-Kufah, the destination of ʿAli (عليه السلام)
key_terms.كُتُبَهُ: his books, referring to preserved written materials

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the transfer of ʿAli’s (عليه السلام) entrusted books and bequest to Al-Hasan (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This narration reports that Amir al-Mu'minin ʿAli (عليه السلام) entrusted his books and the bequest to Umm Salamah before departing to Al-Kufah, and that she later delivered them to Al-Hasan (عليه السلام). It indicates the continuity of entrusted religious authority and the transmission of the Imam's legacy to his rightful successor.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Sayf Bin Ameyra, from Abu Bakr Al Hazamy who said, ‘It was narrated to me by Al Ajlah, and Salma Bin Kuhayl, and Dawood Bin Abu Yazeed Al Yamami who (all) said: ‘Shahr Bin Howshab narrated to us

that Ali<sup>asws</sup>, when he<sup>asws</sup> went to Al-Kufa, deposited with Umm Salma<sup>as</sup> his<sup>asws</sup> Books and the bequest. So when Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> returned (to Al-Medina), she<sup>as</sup> handed over these to him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sayf ibn ‘Amayra from abu Bakr al-Hadrami who has said that al-Ajlah, Salamah ibn Kuhayl, Dawud ibn abu Yazid and Zayd al-Yamami from Shahr ibn Hawshab who has said the following.
